purpose: Restore and prove active runtime consumption of historically validated narrative-architecture components before any live craft parity or revised formal R140.
hypotheses: H1: Explicit Social Ecology Graph and Group Membership/Relations reduce protagonist-centric collapse by distributing independent causal obligations across characters/groups.
H2: Explicit Event/Plot-Axis Ownership survives Episode Allocation -> Detailed Episode Synopsis -> THICK Sequence -> Scene lowering without owner substitution or protagonist hijack.
H3: Detailed Episode Synopsis and THICK Sequence/Boundary provide richer downstream scene contracts than generic episode/sequence summaries while preserving source-state safety.
H4: Consumer-fidelity gates detect and block dormant-field failures where architecture data exists but downstream runtime does not consume it.
H5: One-cycle bidirectional refinement can localize natural architecture defects to the minimum responsible ancestor including Event Ownership/Social Ecology layers without collateral drift.

frozen_development_scope.sample: Existing P07 development set only; no fresh formal sample

consumer_fidelity_gates.G1: Every required stage must be actually invoked; dormant schema/module presence does not count.
consumer_fidelity_gates.G2: Every Event Ownership record must produce at least one downstream episode/sequence/scene semantic consequence or explicit defer receipt.
consumer_fidelity_gates.G3: No owner substitution: downstream event owner must equal upstream owner unless a preregistered ownership-handoff contract is emitted and accepted.
consumer_fidelity_gates.G4: No protagonist hijack: independent plot axes cannot all collapse to protagonist action unless source/state evidence requires it.
consumer_fidelity_gates.G5: Detailed Episode Synopsis anchors must be consumed by THICK Sequence; critical anchor preservation >=95%, critical losses=0.
consumer_fidelity_gates.G6: THICK Sequence fields must be consumed by Scene Plan/Contract; field-existence-only pass is forbidden.
consumer_fidelity_gates.G9: Bidirectional repair chooses minimum responsible ancestor and protected sibling stability >=90%.
consumer_fidelity_gates.G10: All attempts, failures, repair criteria and attempt indices preserved.

mutations: remove thread movement from one THICK sequence
pass_condition: All consumer-fidelity and safety gates pass on development set, all deliberate critical mutations are detected/blocked, and natural no-injection run shows distinct non-protagonist ownership propagation without unsupported invention.
after_pass: Proceed to R-C Decision Architecture Closure; do not start Live Craft Parity yet.
